title: How Does Poetic Verse Contribute to Meaning?
skills: analyze how poetic verse shapes meaning
explain relationships between form and content
identify structural choices that influence emphasis and interpretation
support analysis of poetic form with textual evidence
alignment_note: Examines how poetic verse and structural choices contribute to meaning, emphasis, rhythm, and interpretation. Supports close reading, analysis of form and content, author's craft, and evidence-based discussion of poetry across high school English courses.
